milestones.detail: The Department has approved the Amendment to Settlement Agreement (“Amendment”), dated November 1, 2019, between The Berkshire Gas Company (“Company”) and the Attorney General (“settling parties”). Pursuant to the Amendment, and as further outlined in the settling parties’ responses to DPU SP-12 (Rev.) and DPU SP-13, the Company shall provide to the Department and the Attorney General the remaining Specialized Plant Investment costs, corresponding invoices, and project closing reports no later than March 17, 2020. The Company and Attorney General shall reach agreement on these costs no later than March 31, 2020. The Company shall make a filing with the Department by April 1, 2020, indicating whether an agreement has been reached. If an agreement has not been reached, then the Company, in its April 1, 2020 filing, will seek Department verification of the remaining Specialized Plant Investments costs. Subsequently, the Company shall include in its Winter 2020-2021 LDAF filing, due by August 3, 2020, a revenue requirement calculation (including a reconciliation of cost recovery with the same effect as if all verified Specialized Plant Investment costs had been in effect on December 1, 2019) and the proposed Specialized Plant Investment Factor for effect November 1, 2020.

The Company and Attorney General shall reach agreement on these costs no later than March 31, 2020. The Company shall make a filing with the Department by April 1, 2020, indicating whether an agreement has been reached. If an agreement has not been reached, then the Company, in its April 1, 2020 filing, will seek Department verification of the remaining Specialized Plant Investments costs. Subsequently, the Company shall include in its Winter 2020-2021 LDAF filing, due by August 3, 2020, a revenue requirement calculation (including a reconciliation of cost recovery with the same effect as if all verified Specialized Plant Investment costs had been in effect on December 1, 2019) and the proposed Specialized Plant Investment Factor for effect November 1, 2020.
